integrity: Complete explicit 16-bit unsigned index blocks checked against independently enumerated state sets by Python and C++ programs; independent scholarly audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only even lengths 4,6,8,10; no general even-size algorithm or asymptotic theorem. The 1989 predecessor has year-level publication evidence, not day-level first-public-date evidence. title: Verified single-transposition Gray paths for even alternating permutations through length ten
